explntrNote.note: This fund holds Contingent Convertible Notes, which will convert to an issuing bank's common stock or will be subject to a writedown of its principal should the bank's common equity capital ratio fall beneath a specified threshold (the contingent event). The conversion of debt to equity or the writedown of debt will rebalance the issuer's debt to equity ratio, but as this amount is not known until the occurrence of such contingent event, questions C.9.f.iv and C.9.f.v will be represented as 1.
